MYC expression is regulated by GABPA in multiple tissues, including those of the prostate and liver, where GABPA is active. 3. Experimental data from chromatin immunoprecipitation followed by sequencing (ChIP-seq) indicates strong binding of GABPA to the MYC promoter in human prostate cancer cell lines. 4. RNA-seq data shows a significant correlation between GABPA expression and MYC mRNA levels in mesenchymal stem cells. 5. The combined evidence from binding studies and expression correlation across multiple relevant tissues supports a high confidence level of 0.82 for this regulatory relationship."
